name: Kirchheim am Ries (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and red, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Kirchheim am Ries (a white church above a saltire on red).
history: Municipal flag of Kirchheim am Ries; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Kirchheim am Ries arms — church on red
